meta.name: git
meta.description: Git operations, branching strategy, commit conventions, and PR workflow. Use for all git operations. Enforces clean history and conventional commits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理分支与提交,让代码版本历史干净且规整
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需用命令行打理代码版本与提交规范
copy.tagline_en: Keep commit history clean with clear branch and merge workflows.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with code versioning on the command line.

howto.what: Claude 按预设分支策略管分支，用 Conventional Commits 写提交，按模板和清单处理 PR，强制推送等高风险操作会先确认。
howto.when: 当用户请求任何 Git 操作时触发，如分支管理、提交代码、创建 PR 等。

say.text: 创建一个 feature/ 分支，基于 develop。
say.note: Claude 会按分支策略创建分支。

say.text: 用 Conventional Commits 规范生成这条提交信息。
say.note: Claude 会按规范格式化提交。

say.text: 按 PR 模板为当前分支创建 PR。
say.note: Claude 会生成 PR 描述和检查清单。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the branching strategy, writes Conventional Commits, handles PRs per template and checklist, and requires confirmation for high-risk ops like force-push.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests any git operation, e.g., branch management, committing, creating PRs.

say_en.text: Create a feature/ branch based on develop.
Write this commit message following Conventional Commits.
Create a PR for the current branch using the template.
